in_marathi.name: Sharvendra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of All
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sharvendra is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Sharva’ meaning auspicious and ‘Indra’ meaning Lord of all. Thus, Sharvendra is the name of the Lord who is the ruler of all.
